overview.description: The ProShares Ultra Consumer Discretionary (UCC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer discretionary equity. The fund provides 2x exposure to a market cap-weighted index of US consumer discretionary stocks drawn from the S&P 500. UCC was launched on Jan 30, 2007 and is issued by ProShares.
